summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Optowire Angular 21 SSR catalog. Found and fixed 2 critical bugs: (1) /ext proxy forwarding Origin header causing 401 from external API, preventing products from loading on homepage and all browser-side fetches; (2) global header search using '?q=' param but catalog reading '?search=' param (mismatch). Both fixed, rebuilt, and verified. All 8 requested features now passing.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: /ext proxy was forwarding browser Origin and Referer headers to external API (api-prod.optowire.net). External API responded with 401 'Not allowed by CORS' for any browser request. Curl without Origin returned 201 - this was the root cause. Fixed by adding removeHeader('origin') and removeHeader('referer') in the proxyReq handler in server.ts.

FIXED: Header global search navigates to /catalog?q=<term> but catalog.ts read params.get('search') not params.get('q'). This meant header search redirected to catalog with ?q= but the filter was never applied (showed all 1138 products). Fixed by reading both 'q' and 'search' params in catalog.ts queryParamMap subscriber.

NOTE: 404 for /ext/web/category/<slug>/attributes when loading leaf-level categories (e.g. odn-optical-distribution-node). This means no attribute filters show in sidebar for such categories. Non-critical - products still load correctly.
NOTE: SSR hostname errors in frontend.err.log are from BEFORE the allowedHosts fix was deployed (old runs). Current build (4th server start) returns 200 for all page requests. Verified via curl.

NOTE: Angular app manifest (angular-app-engine-manifest.mjs) has specific preview hostnames but NOT catalog-preview-13. The server.ts wildcard '*.preview.emergentagent.com' correctly covers this via the Ds() function's endsWith logic.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Angular 21 SSR app. External API: https://api-prod.optowire.net (proxied via /ext). Key fix: proxy strips Origin/Referer headers. Global search uses ?q= param and catalog now reads both ?q= and ?search=. Product count: 1138 total, Telecommunication=865, ODN=85. App must be rebuilt (yarn build) and frontend restarted for code changes. SSR hostname whitelist in server.ts covers *.preview.emergentagent.com wildcard.

bug1_proxy_401.root_cause: http-proxy-middleware by default forwards all request headers including 'Origin' and 'Referer' from the browser. The external API (api-prod.optowire.net) validates the Origin header and returns 401 'Not allowed by CORS' for unknown origins. Without these headers (curl), the API accepts requests and returns 201.
bug1_proxy_401.fix: Added proxyReq.removeHeader('origin') and proxyReq.removeHeader('referer') in the /ext proxy's proxyReq handler in server.ts.
bug1_proxy_401.impact: Homepage product sections (New Arrivals, Top Products) showed 'No products found'. All browser-side API calls failing with 401.

bug2_search_param_mismatch.root_cause: header.ts navigates to /catalog?q=<term> but catalog.ts reads params.get('search'). The 'q' param was silently ignored, catalog loaded all 1138 products regardless of search term.
bug2_search_param_mismatch.fix: Updated catalog.ts to read both 'q' and 'search' params: `params.get('q') || params.get('search')`. Also added loadProducts() call when search term is set via URL param.
